latest_release.name: v0.3.18.252432
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
- Improve Google Apps support (#3867, #3926). Thanks @DaVinci9196.
- Vending: Open work app store when enabled (#3947). Thanks @jonathanklee.
- reCAPTCHA: Add support for ModAC (QR-code based reCAPTCHA flow, #3695). Thanks @DaVinci9196.
- Location: Make timeline per Google account (#3670). Thanks @DaVinci9196.
- Vision/MLKit: Add support for document scanning (#3843). Thanks @grenadin.
- Maps: Make extracted native library read-only (fixes support for Android 17, #3883). Thanks @SaeedDev94.
- Fido: Ignore unknown key alg instead of rejecting the full request (#3917). Thanks @p1gp1g.
- Add CameraLowLightService (#3646). Thanks @DaVinci9196.
- Auth:
  - Add support for account features and storage requests (#3723). Thanks @DaVinci9196.
  - Fix requests for auth tokens (AuroraStore bug).
- PoToken: Minor improvements.
- Minor Fixes (#3822). Thanks @Fs00.
- New/Updated translations for Czech, Malay, Bulgarian, Chinese (Simplified), Norwegian, Arabic, Polish, Romanian, Russian, Ukrainian, Czech, Thai, Portuguese (Brazil), Irish, Turkish, Italian, French. Thanks @Fjuro, @Jacob7179, @bobacheto, @Uzzal97, @why200924-cell, @lucasmz-dev and unnamed Weblate translators.
- Full Changelog: https://github.com/microg/GmsCore/compare/v0.3.17.252432...v0.3.18.252432

## New Contributors
- @SaeedDev94 made their first contribution in https://github.com/microg/GmsCore/pull/3883

## Release artifacts
- Users on devices with an aftermarket custom operating system ("Custom ROM") that supports microG should install `com.google.android.gms-250932036.apk` and `com.android.vending-84022636.apk`. These versions are also distributed through the microG F-Droid repository.
- Users on Huawei devices running original operating system (EMUI or HarmonyOS) that supports microG should install `com.google.android.gms-250932036-hw.apk` and `com.android.vending-84022636-hw.apk`. These versions are also distributed through Huawei AppGallery.
- `org.microg.gms-250932036-user.apk` is a development preview for special situations. Do not use it except if you know why.
